## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages--conventional-commits-required)
- [ ] `cd backend && npm test && npm run build` passes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build` passes
- [ ] Pure logic changes have unit tests; secrets are never logged or echoed
